steps.content: As you step into the Square Black Ring ruins, the scenery around you starts to change rapidly.
A red apparition materializes out of nowhere before you, speaking in an incomprehensible language.
You look around to find the FAC soldiers unbothered by the apparition. It seems that only you and Yanyan can see the unusual scene. A slight tingling sensation is pricking the top of your head.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Revered Divine Lord, Sunsink City's novice seer Yanyan is at your service.
Yanyan devoutly kneels in the direction of the apparition, which is flickering and emitting a red light continuously. Uncertain of what it wants, you can only stay alert and get your shackles ready.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, the Divine Lord is about to tell me about the trials.
After saying that, Yanyan sits up straight and closes her eyes. Soon after, her body emits bursts of red light as she speaks in the same mysterious language as the red apparition does.
Yanyan struggles to repeat the words uttered by the apparition, her body trembling uncontrollably, sweat already soaking her clothes.
Like Yanyan, you too can feel that immense mental pressure as the screeches and wails never cease. You think of interrupting Yanyan's channeling, but can't bring yourself to do it.
After what feels like an eternity, the apparition vanishes and the ritual is complete. Yanyan struggles to her feet and takes your hand.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...I, I understood the Divine Lord's decree! The trials will be difficult. We must work hard together to complete them! For the first trial...
Everyone waits quietly to hear the Divine Lord's trial. There's no other sound than their breathing.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Fetch two basins of bathing water for the Sun Crow from the Spring Valley!
